def solve(values):
    expected = 0
    actual = 0
    for index, value in enumerate(values):
        expected ^= index
        actual ^= value
    return expected ^ len(values) ^ actual

def solve(root):
    values = []

    def dfs(node):
        if not node:
            values.append('#')
            return
        values.append(str(node.val))
        dfs(node.left)
        dfs(node.right)

    dfs(root)
    return values

def solve(root):
    values = []

    def dfs(node):
        if not node:
            values.append('#')
            return
        values.append(str(node.val))
        dfs(node.left)
        dfs(node.right)

    dfs(root)
    return values
